title: Strategic Account Manager I
description: Who You Are You think about an account the way its leadership does. You take the time to understand the customer's business model, strategic priorities, what they're measured on, and how events tie to their strategic priorities and goals, who the key stakeholders are and what’s important to them. Retention and growth follows from that. You have strong business acumen and commercial skills, you're curious and you drive discovery that surfaces unstated opportunities, you’re analytical, use judgment and exercise critical thinking, and are comfortable making a commercial case with real numbers behind it. You manage your accounts from a position of strength based on your knowledge and insights into your accounts. You see the big picture and can get into the details when it matters. You work well with others, share what you know, and you're a few steps ahead of risk instead of reacting to it. If you like building long-term partnerships and pushing for growth when the opportunity is there, you'll be right at home at Swoogo . What You'll Do You'll report to the VP of Account Management and own a portfolio of high-value accounts. You will deliver retention and expansion from knowing your customers' priorities better than anyone else on the account and showing them value long before renewal comes up. You'll work closely with CSMs, Finance, Legal, and Product. A strategic renewal here means it's tied to an account plan, positioned against the competition, and backed by a multi-year story about the value the customer is getting, not just a contract that gets signed on time. Every day will look a little different, but in general you will: Build and keep an account profile and plan for each customer, company profile and strategic priorities, use case and recommendations, whitespace and expansion analysis, and event tech stack, so you know where the growth is before anyone asks. Map the stakeholders and buying committee in each account: who has influence, who makes the decision, what’s important to each stakeholder and what the politics look like. Run effective discovery to find the priorities customers haven't said out loud, and use what you learn to shape the plan. Build the business case with each customer. Executive business reviews are where you connect Swoogo to their own strategic goals and show quantified ROI and outcomes. Develop multi-threaded relationships with senior stakeholders and act as a trusted advisor to them. Spot renewal risk early in partnership with CSMs and decide when to push, when to hold, and when to bring in help. Negotiate multi-year agreements from a position of knowledge, with the customer's usage, value, and alternatives in hand. Keep track of the competitive landscape, industry trends and other event solutions used at the customer’s organization. Work with Finance, Legal, and Product to structure deals that make sense for both sides. Bring customer insights to leadership to inform pricing, packaging, and the product roadmap. Kee

title: Spontanansökan - Sjuksköterska i psykiatri
description: Om Nova Psykiatri Nova Psykiatri grundades med en vision om att revolutionera psykiatrin och behandling av psykiska ohälsa. Vi strävar efter att erbjuda en modern och patientcentrerad vårdupplevelse. Vi vill erbjuda bästa Europas bästa utredning och behandling för personer med ADHD, Autism och annan psykiatrisk problematik. Dagens psykiatri präglas av traditionella metoder och ett ofta långsamt arbetssätt, där tekniska framsteg och patientens behov sällan står i fokus. Många patienter har svårt att navigera i ett komplext offentligt system eller vänder sig till stora vårdgivare där de riskerar att bli en anonym siffra i mängden. Vi har valt att göra saker annorlunda genom att sätta patienten i centrum och erbjuda psykiatrisk vård med en femstjärnig service. Vår strategi bygger på patientupplevelse, kvalitet och effektivitet, där vi använder modern teknik och innovativa arbetsmetoder för att ständigt förbättra och utveckla vår verksamhet. Vårt engagerade team är kärnan i vår verksamhet och består främst av psykologer, läkare och sjuksköterskor. Nova Psykiatri grundades i januari 2024 och har idag 70+ medarbetare – och vi växer snabbt. Nu söker vi fler drivna personer som vill vara med och forma framtidens psykiatri tillsammans med oss. Vi lägger mycket fokus på att anställa Sveriges duktigaste medarbetare, men även att folk ska trivas bättre här än någon annanstans. Novas vision är att visa hur psykiatri kan fungera, för såväl patienter som för medarbetare. Vi tror det går att göra mycket bättre. Vi drivs av att hela tiden förbättra patientnöjdheten, hålla hög kvalitet, och samtidigt höja effektiviteten genom minskad administration. Vi tror att vi når allt detta genom att ha kul tillsammans, våga göra misstag, samt genom att våga sträva mot att vara bäst på det vi gör. Om rollen Vi är ett företag i tillväxt med ett fortlöpande behov av att rekrytera fler duktiga sjuksköterskor som vill bidra till en förstklassig patientupplevelse. Just nu har vi ingen öppen tjänst, men skicka gärna in din ansökan redan i dag så hör vi av oss när det blir dags igen! Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av insättning och uppföljning av CS-medicinering och som vill bli en del av vårt engagerade team. Arbetet sker på distans från valfri plats i Sverige, där du får möjlighet att arbeta flexibelt och planera dina arbetsveckor på ett sätt som passar dig. Vem vi söker Sjuksköterska inom psykiatri. Meriterande om du har erfarenhet av insättning och uppföljning av CS-medicinering. Trivs med att arbeta självständigt och som värdesätter frihet under ansvar. Vi letar efter dig som är intresserad av att kombinera effektivitet, kvalitet och patientnöjdhet i ditt arbete. Du är även driven, gillar att utvecklas och öppen för förändringar. Du ser patienten som någon vars förväntningar du alltid vill försöka överträffa, och du vill hela tiden förbättras. Vi söker en sjuksköterska i psykiatri som kan möta och behandla en bred patientbas. Vår verksamhet är inriktad på flera patientgrupper

title: Machine Learning Engineer (Egocentric 3D Human Pose)
description: About the Role We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join our core research and development team focused on recovering accurate 3D human body and hand motion from egocentric (first-person) video. In this role, you will develop models and production pipelines that transform head-mounted and body-mounted camera streams—including wide-FOV, stereo, motion-blurred, and heavily self-occluded video—into metrically accurate, temporally consistent 3D pose representations for robot policy training and human-to-robot motion retargeting. Improve temporal consistency and physical plausibility using filtering, kinematic constraints, multi-view fusion, and multi-modal sensor integration. Strong understanding of multi-view geometry, camera calibration, triangulation, coordinate transformations, and projection models. Strong Python programming skills and proficiency with PyTorch or TensorFlow. Solid knowledge of modern deep learning techniques, model training, evaluation, and production ML workflows. title: Founding Deployment Strategist [ERP + AI]
description: TL;DR We're building the SAP/NetSuite of the AI era for mid-sized companies in the real-world economy, starting with their supply chain operations (buy, sell, stock, produce) Founding deployment strategist : you deploy two things into real factories, in the same project, the ERP that runs their operations, and the AI agents that work inside it. Every client goes from signed contract to go-live on the date we promised, running on Piston, with agents already doing part of the work A rare shape: someone who has led client projects that landed in industrial companies, who is genuinely AI-native, and who will write the deployment playbook for the team and our system integrator partners €3M Pre-seed (Top-tier VCs) €45–60k + equity What this role is (and isn't) Most ERP deployments are people moving data around for a year. Incumbents quote six figures for it, and the client gets the same software they had, just newer. Ours run in eight to twelve weeks and deliver two things at once: a new ERP that runs buying, selling, stock and production, and AI agents inside it that read the orders, recompute the production load, prepare the purchases, and ask a human only when it matters. This is not a product or a sales role, you are a deployment strategist. In one project, you replace a company's ERP and you put AI agents to work inside it. Why now Since day one, the founders have run every deployment themselves. Clients are now coming in faster than we can handle, and we need someone to own deployments. You work directly with Eric, CEO, who also leads product. That puts you as close as it gets to what success means at Piston: the success of our clients. What you'll do Deploy the ERP, with AI. The client's sales, purchasing, stock and production move onto Piston: data migrated from their old ERP and their Excel files, configuration built from their own documents, training, go-live. AI does the heavy lifting, you do the judgment. Put the first AI agents live, during the ERP deployment. You decide what each agent does on its own, what it hands to a human for approval, and you make sure it's still running three months later. Write the deployment playbook. Every go-live feeds a playbook that our next deployment hires and our system integrator partners will follow. Map where the client's time goes. On site, you find the work that eats people's days: re-keying orders, chasing suppliers, rebuilding the same Excel every month. That map is the backlog of the next agents. Teach humans to work with agents. The people you deploy with have never supervised software that acts on its own. You show them how to trust it, check it and correct it. Hold the date and the budget. You size each deployment before the contract and protect that budget. Use the tools engineers build for you. Our engineers build the tools that let you deploy on your own: AI-assisted data migration from the client's old ERP and Excel files, and a builder for screens and agents. You tell them what slows you do

You will create prompts that are difficult enough for a frontier model to fail, then write a scoring rubric for each task so reviewers can assess the output consistently.
